messages:
marie (support): FYI customer (ACME) reported a p99 spike tonight ~02:10 UTC. p95 fine, p99 up to 7-12s. They see a bunch of attach errors + 401s during warmup. Can we triage?

emma (support): ticket #5872 linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-5872. Affected route: /v1/generate, model pinned: redwood-7b-q4_v2. Recurs daily.

marie (support): pasted logs from attach-proxy:
```
[2026-03-16T02:10:12Z] attach request id=tx-9f1c attach_time_ms=0 status=queued
[2026-03-16T02:10:32Z] attach request id=tx-9f1c attempt=1 image_pull=21000 warmup_err="startup script timeout"
[2026-03-16T02:10:33Z] auth-token id=tok-44 expired=true result=401
[2026-03-16T02:10:45Z] attach request id=tx-9f1c attempt=2 attach_time_ms=12345 status=attached
```

infra-bot: metric snapshot (last 5m): queue_len=18, prepare_workers=10/10, gpu_util=92%, image_pull_failures=3, attach_latency_p99=12000ms.

raj (sre): I see the scale-up queue spike and the dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-west-2' is at max_prepared (10/10). When image pulls delay, warmup retries push attach past token TTL -> auth 401s. Likely cascade: image pull -> warmup failure -> retry -> attach delay -> token expiry.

oliver (eng-platform): quick look at provisioner logs: several hosts reported slow image pulls (~18-25s) coinciding with registry throttling window. Warmup script retries without jitter so many warmups align and overload pulls. Also noticed min_pool for that pool is 0 (customer small tier) so cold starts are common.

emma (support): customer on Dedicated small (min_pool=0). They asked for a mitigation ASAP — cannot afford p99 10s for user-facing demo.

marie (support): proposed mitigations: 1) set min_pool=1 for dedicated-eu-west-2, 2) enable prewarm for priority queue, 3) temporarily raise attach timeout to 45s and bump token refresh window to refresh earlier, 4) set fallback route to redwood-7b-q3 (faster warmup).

raj (sre): agree. Quick commands to run now: 
```
# provisional emergency fixes
redwoodctl pool update dedicated-eu-west-2 --min-pool 1 --prewarm true
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --attach-timeout 45s --fallback-model redwood-7b-q3
```

oliver (eng-platform): I'll push two changes: ensure registry rate limits handled with exponential backoff + jitter in warmup; add image caching on hosts; and add an auto-fallback that serves redwood-7b-q3 if attach_time > 8s. I'll open ENG-PLAT-4321.

infra-bot: applied pool update, prewarm toggle, and route change. Change-id=chg-20260316-01.

marie (support): patch applied. Emma — can you confirm with customer during the next 02:10 window?

emma (support): customer confirmed in next cycle: p99 dropped to ~450ms, no 401s observed. They said experience is restored. Leaving note in ticket. :thumbsup:

raj (sre): leaving follow-up items: 1) root cause: registry throttling + zero min_pool causing cold attach thundering herd, 2) durable fixes: registry-side retries & jitter, image caching, and default min_pool >=1 for priority customers.

oliver (eng-platform): created ENG-PLAT-4321: "warmup jitter, image caching, fallback policy" and tagged for v next release. ETA 2 weeks.

marie (support): closing escalation for now; re-open if customer sees recurrence. Thanks all.

emma (support): closing on ticket #5872.
